title: Filipino food agency steps up enforcement and controls
content:
The food agency in the Philippines has revealed the results of stricter enforcement measures in the first half of this year.

The country's Food and Drug Administration faced challenges such as limited manpower, process inefficiencies, and backlogs driven by increasing applications.

title: Imported organic berries recalled because of E. coli contamination and outbreak
content:
